title: Operator acceptance scenarios from fresh install through recovery

scenario_groups.claim: A clean workspace exposes explicit bootstrap guidance and can be bootstrapped through the product path.
success_criteria: status --health classifies the workspace as bootstrap_required before any runtime state exists
doctor remains machine-readable and points at the bootstrap path even if other backend checks are still degraded
the first watch run creates .ft/, .ft/logs, and the database under the workspace
failure_criteria: status --health reports a generic error without first-run guidance
doctor output stops being machine-readable or hides the next-step commands
the watch bootstrap path does not create the runtime directories and database

scenario_groups.claim: A broken backend environment is diagnosed through actionable doctor output rather than silent failure.
success_criteria: the WezTerm CLI check is marked as an error
operator guidance status is blocked with a concrete remediation step
failure_criteria: doctor succeeds despite a broken backend bridge
the output lacks a concrete remediation command or install hint

scenario_groups.claim: The standard incident entry path routes through the new diagnostic surfaces and points operators at recovery commands.
success_criteria: all three surfaces classify the seeded incident as recovery_required
the next-step commands point at watch, session list, or snapshot inspection
failure_criteria: any surface hides the unclean-session condition
recovery guidance does not include a concrete next step

scenario_groups.claim: After the incident state is repaired, session persistence returns to a healthy classification.
success_criteria: session doctor reports healthy after the unclean marker is cleared
session inventory remains queryable after the repair
failure_criteria: session doctor continues to report recovery_required after the repair
session inventory becomes unreadable or inconsistent

scenario_groups.claim: The finish-line operator story is anchored by retained large-fleet tuning and release-gate evidence instead of chat-only narrative.
success_criteria: the blessed tuning package is still validated
the release-gate evaluator remains reproducible with stored artifacts
failure_criteria: operator guidance references stale or missing artifacts
the cross-check commands cannot be replayed from repository state

exact_verification_commands: CC=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang CXX=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ft-cod2-target rch exec -- cargo check -p frankenterm
remaining_gaps: Live pane control and long-haul swarm activity still cross the WezTerm-backed mux boundary; this bundle treats those as evidence-backed operator paths, not pure local mocks.
The macOS-specific clang recipe is retained exactly because the user requested it, but Linux RCH workers may fail before Rust compilation if that toolchain path is absent.
